card.name: First piece of brand drug names
card.fires_on: The first or second piece of an uncommon brand drug name written in capitals, such as SKYTROFA, AQVESME, AYVAKIT or YCANTH, usually right after words like 'of' or 'with'. It fires before the rest of the name is spelled out.

modes.label: Brand name start after of/with
modes.description: The opening piece of a brand name directly after a phrase like 'treatment with' or 'starting dose of'.
modes.example: The recommended starting dose of<< SK>>YTROFA in adults with GHD

modes.label: Inside a brand name
modes.description: A middle piece of a brand name partway through its spelling.
modes.example: 7.2 Effects of A<<Y>>VAKIT on Other Drugs Hormonal

card.plain: It lights up on the first letters of a newly named brand drug, before the full name is spelled out.
